name: Wufoo
label: Wufoo — REST API v3 forms and entries
description: Official Wufoo REST API v3 at https://{subdomain}.wufoo.com/api/v3/. Handler: OfficialApiNode. HTTP Basic (api_key as username). JSON only (.json). Entries are respondent PII. Customer owns the Wufoo account. Minimize; never log api_key, handshakeKey, or field values. trigger.listen is BPMN message-event ingress. Docs: https://wufoo.github.io/docs/
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. subdomain and identifier may come from config. File fields: type file. Do not put api_key here. handshakeKey is only for webhook.register. Example: {"operation":"form.list"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: form.list | form.get | entry.list | entry.submit | webhook.register | trigger.listen.

schema.label: subdomain
schema.description: Account subdomain (^[a-z0-9-]+$). Else config. Host only — interpolated into {subdomain}.wufoo.com.

schema.label: identifier
schema.description: Form hash (preferred) or title. Else config form_hash.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Wufoo entry.submit field map using the form's FieldN ids as keys (Field1, Field2, …). Required. Example: {"Field1":"Ada","Field2":"ada@example.com"}. https://wufoo.github.io/docs/#submit-entry

schema.label: sort
schema.description: entry.list field id to sort by.

schema.label: handshakeKey
schema.description: Webhook handshake for webhook.register. Echoed as HandshakeKey.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. May contain PII — never log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: form.list | form.get | entry.list | entry.submit | webhook.register | trigger.listen. trigger.listen is ingress.

configurationParameters.label: Subdomain
configurationParameters.description: Account subdomain (fishbowl in docs). Hostname label only: {subdomain}.wufoo.com. Allowlist ^[a-z0-9-]+$.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: 16-character key from Form Manager → API Information (StudioQuack secret). HTTP Basic username. OfficialApiNode also sends the same value as the Basic password (Wufoo accepts any non-empty password). Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Form hash
configurationParameters.description: Default form hash used as path {identifier}. Overridable on INPUT as identifier.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
